summary.text: Martin Heinrich has been a U.S. Senator from New Mexico since 2012 and is Ranking Member of the Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: He previously served two terms in the U.S. House of Representatives, and before that four years on the Albuquerque City Council, where he was elected council president.
He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Missouri and began his career as a contractor at Phillips Laboratories at Kirtland Air Force Base.
